note: Five systems, one attempt and 24 hours per problem, graded by about 30 referees for correctness, exposition and attribution. Every problem was solved by at least one system: the ProofCouncil harness solved 9 of 10 ($1,888) and GPT-6 Astra used directly 7 ($36), while an open-weight system built on Kimi K3 solved none. Exposition and citations remain weak, and the best results take far more compute, raising concern about access for ordinary researchers.
title: First Proof, Third Batch: results
